_comment: Sample reviews dataset for the ShaadiSahulat AI Review module. Used as a reference corpus for sentiment calibration and as inspiration for the review generator. Not strictly required at runtime (VADER is rule-based) but kept here so the module can be upgraded to a learned model without changing the API.
